title: Scalar compatibility of affine realization
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category], U an affine open, A=Gamma(U,O_X), and R derived over-site restriction. Let F:D(A) -> D(O_X over U) have a natural comparison Q followed by F with Q of termwise affinePerfectSheafification [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model]. For every A-module complex K, every derived object E of X, every isomorphism e:F(Q(K)) -> R(E), and every global scalar a [def-sc-derived-global-scalar], F(a|U times id_Q(K)) followed by e.hom equals e.hom followed by R(schemeDerivedScalar X a id_E). Neither perfectness, quasi-coherence of E, nor support is required.

source.place: Tag 06Z0, termwise associated-sheaf construction; Tag 08EJ affine scalar action

proof.text: On the localized site use the linear structure over compatible local sections. The global family a restricts to overSections U (a(U)), by its compatibility equation. Componentwise extensionality proves overFunctor maps a times the identity to this restricted scalar identity. Apply this termwise to complexes. Naturality of mapDerivedCategoryFactors and linearity of Q prove the same identity on Q(L). Essential surjectivity of Q and conjugation by its object-preimage isomorphism prove it for any E. All these steps are proved in the private restriction_scalar lemma.

Use affine_perfect_sheafification_scalar on each K.X n. Complex-morphism extensionality yields the termwise scalar identity. Naturality of the given comparison Q followed by F, linearity of both Q functors, and cancellation of the comparison component give F(a(U) times id_Q(K)) = overSections U (a(U)) times id_F(Q(K)).
Scalar multiplication commutes with every morphism in the target linear derived category, in particular e.hom. Rewrite the two scalar identities proved above to obtain the asserted equality.
